1978.name: Kids Night Out | Pot of Gold | Ages 5-12 | 03/13
1978.description:
Kids Night Out

6:30pm - 9:30pm

Ages 5-13

$45

Description

Kids Night Out is packed with excitement and variety! The evening kicks off with a quick warm-up and stretch, followed by time on our ninja obstacles and gymnastics stations. Afterward, everyone comes together for a fun group game before heading to the party area for a pizza dinner, included in the price. Post-dinner, kids enjoy Open Gym time where they can pick their favorite activities across the gym. The night wraps up with a themed activity related to that evening’s special theme. For those looking to wind down, we also offer cool-down options in the lobby like board games, coloring, and a movie, giving kids a chance to relax before heading home!

What to Wear & Bring to Class

Your child can wear a leotard or comfortable athletic attire that covers the belly. Kids will go barefoot in the gym, but if your child wants to try out the Ninja equipment during Open Gym, please pack a pair of tennis shoes. Also, don’t forget to bring a water bottle to keep them hydrated throughout the night!

1979.name: Movie Night | Zootopia 2 | Ages 5-12 | 03/20
1979.description:
Movie Night

7:00pm - 9:30pm

Ages 5-13

$30

They’ll help set up mats and equipment to create comfortable spots to relax while the movie is projected onto the wall. Once everything is ready, everyone will enjoy a pizza for dinner (included in the price) before settling in for the movie.

During the film, kids will enjoy a themed craft or special movie snack that ties into the night’s featured movie. For anyone who wants a break from the screen, quiet options will be available in the lobby, including coloring, board games, and a movie-friendly chill space. 

What to Wear & Bring to Movie Night :Kids should wear comfortable clothing they can relax in during the movie. Cozy socks are encouraged, and you’re welcome to send a small blanket or pillow to make their movie spot extra comfy. Don’t forget a water bottle to keep them hydrated throughout the evening!

1926.name: Week 1: Beach Bash| Parkour & Ninja Summer Camp 2026 | Full Day | Ages 5+ | May 26th|NO CAMP MONDAY
1926.description:
Summer Camp - Parkour & Ninja Warrior Full Day Camp (NO CAMP ON MONDAY)

Ages 5-13

$390/ Week or $90/day

School's out and camp is in! Tackle our epic ninja course, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Co-Ed Ninja Camps. Campers will enjoy open gym, structured ninja and trampoline rotations, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun. We provide one morning snack per child each day. If your child would like an additional snack, feel free to pack one from home. For those attending full-day camp, please make sure to send a packed lunch, as lunch is not provided.

What to Wear & Bring to Class

Kids should wear comfortable athletic clothing—think t-shirts, tank tops, shorts, or leggings—that allows them to move freely and safely. Please avoid clothing with zippers, buttons, or snaps, as these can get caught on equipment or cause discomfort. Closed-toe athletic shoes with non-slip soles are required for the ninja course; shoes should have secure fastenings like laces or Velcro to stay firmly in place. Slip-on or loose-fitting shoes are not allowed. Long hair should be tied back neatly, and don’t forget to pack a water bottle to help your child stay hydrated throughout class!

Camp Details:

  • Camp is Non-Refundable
  • Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability
  • Must pre-register & pre-pay
